name: usage-widget
description: A calm usage strip above the prompt: context, your plan's 5-hour and weekly limits or a monthly budget with pace, and what this chat cost. You choose what it shows, and a Usage pane adds resets, projections and the context trend.

strip.title: Strip shows
strip.description: Which plan limits the strip shows. A hidden limit comes back while it needs attention.

showContext.title: Show context
showContext.description: Show the context window in the strip.

showCost.title: Show this chat's cost
showCost.description: Show what this chat has cost in the strip.

monthlyBudget.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthlyBudget.description: Used only when your account reports no monthly budget of its own. 0 for none.
